info.name: Secureworks Taegis XDR Authentication GraphQL API

items.docs: Execute a GraphQL query or mutation against the Taegis XDR platform. The Taegis XDR API is primarily a GraphQL API supporting the following domains: Alerts, Audits, Collectors, Connectors, Endpoint Assets, Identities, Investigations, Playbooks, Threat Intelligence, BYOTI, Countermeasures, File Upload, Notifications, Tenants, and Users.
